n5e.sourceTraits:
[BOX]
| Mind Body Transfer – Mental Overwrite / Max Ranks: 5, [Mental], [Sensory] / Pockets of the casters consciousness are overwriting yours. Your thoughts become hazy. Your movements sluggish and you begin to believe, not even your own. The strength of this jutsu depends on the mental strength of the target. Creatures lose 1 rank of Mental Overwrite at the end of each of their turns, unless they are Dominated. / Applies to Minions / With 1 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated (see effect), until dispelled. / Applies to Standards / With 3 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 hour. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Elites / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 minute. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Solo’s / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated until the end of their next turn. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Player Characters / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated, remaking their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending it on a successful save. |
[/BOX]
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Int, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Insight
Yamanaka Techniques: The Yamanaka Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Yamanaka Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.
Telepathic Comms: Once per long rest, select a number of willing creatures equal to 1+Proficienty bonus that you can reach during this rest. Until you all complete a long rest, you can telepathically communicate with one another, conveying your thoughts to one another at will, so long as you are within 1 mile of each other. If any of you are ever in a structure with chakra based or enhanced walls, you cannot communicate with that creature using this trait.

system.description:
A bandit walks into his group's main tent and demands to speak to their leader. The leader approaches him annoyed and confused “What is the meaning of this Dan?” the bandit leader demands. “I just got word from our scouts that the shinobi posted just past the hilltops are moving out. They are leaving! We need to act now boss.” he exclaims. The bandit leader looks shocked but takes his underling at his word. He commands his officers to get everyone up and moving now. If the shinobi are gone ow is the time to move through the hill pass. Dan bows and begins to make his way out of the tent. As he exits, he holds his head and almost collapses before catching himself and grumbling, “What happened?” About 400 Yards away hidden in the brush of a large tree, Leena begins to wake up looking at her 2 allies and raising a thumb of success. “They took the bait, hook line and sinker.” She says as her allies inform the awaiting ambush party.

—Tatsunami Aburame, The Long Road, Ch. 14 excerpt.

Impossible to Pin Down

The Yamanaka Clan is a family of shinobi found in Konohagakure. They specialize in mind related techniques, and they own and run a flower shop in the village. They traditionally lead the Konoha Barrier Team. The members of this clan specialize in mind-related techniques which makes them experts at intelligence gathering, espionage and interrogation amongst other things. They have also displayed sensory abilities and their techniques include transferring their consciousness, reading minds and communicating telepathically. The Yamanaka clan has a special relationship with the Akimichi and Nara clan. For generations, members of these three families have formed an "Ino–Shika–Cho Trio", named after the first part of the names of the members.

Yamanaka Traits

| Mind Body Transfer – Mental Overwrite / Max Ranks: 5, [Mental], [Sensory] / Pockets of the casters consciousness are overwriting yours. Your thoughts become hazy. Your movements sluggish and you begin to believe, not even your own. The strength of this jutsu depends on the mental strength of the target. Creatures lose 1 rank of Mental Overwrite at the end of each of their turns, unless they are Dominated. / Applies to Minions / With 1 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated (see effect), until dispelled. / Applies to Standards / With 3 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 hour. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Elites / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 minute. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Solo’s / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated until the end of their next turn. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Player Characters / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated, remaking their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending it on a successful save. |

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Int, +1 Cha

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Insight

Yamanaka Techniques: The Yamanaka Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Yamanaka Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.

Telepathic Comms: Once per long rest, select a number of willing creatures equal to 1+Proficienty bonus that you can reach during this rest. Until you all complete a long rest, you can telepathically communicate with one another, conveying your thoughts to one another at will, so long as you are within 1 mile of each other. If any of you are ever in a structure with chakra based or enhanced walls, you cannot communicate with that creature using this trait.

Yamanaka Features

Mind Body Transfer

1st Level Clan Feature

The Yamanaka clan are known for their mind-altering abilities allowing them to inject their consciousness into bodies of their foes, taking their bodily autonomy away. But this takes focus, accuracy, the confidence that your team will be there to support you and above all, requires you to enter the Mind Disruption chakra stance. You can enter your Mind Disruption stance as a bonus action. While in this stance you gain the following benefits:

Mind Body Transfer. As an action, or in place of an attack you make as part of the Attack action or a Jutsu you cast, you can select a creature you can see within 60 feet of you and send a mental echo into them, as a beam. Constructs, inanimate objects, creatures not native to this world and creatures immune to the Compelled or Sealed conditions are immune to this feature.

Beam: You release a direct shot of your psionic frequency. Make a ranged attack using your highest jutsu modifier. On a hit, you deal 1d6 + modifier in psychic damage, and they gain 1 rank of Mental Overwrite. This increases to 2d6 and 2 ranks at 11th level.

Pulse: Beginning at 7th level, you can make an attack, pulsing waves of psionic intrusion, forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Mental Overwrite. This increases to 3 ranks at 15th level. This does not reveal you if you are hidden.

Wave: Beginning at 15th level, you can instead make an aura of psionic intrusion. All creatures of your choice within a radius, half the range of this feature, centering on you must make a Charisma saving throw, taking 5d6 psychic damage and inflicting 1 rank of Mental Overwrite on a failure.

Mental Recalibration

| #### Dominated / Extended Condition / A Dominated creature has their wills overwritten by the inflicting creature, known as the Dominator. The Dominator imposes the following effects on the Dominated and themselves. You can normally be a Dominator to one creature at a time, unless otherwise specified. / Dominator Effects / The Dominators body falls limp. Becoming Stunned, Blind, Deafened and incapacitated, for the duration of this status. / The Dominator takes over the body of the Dominated, meaning they now act in initiative, when the Dominated would act, speaks in their voice, dialect, languages and even has knowledge of their mannerisms. / The Dominator gains limited access to the Dominated statistics, becoming aware of their General and Clan traits, if any. / The Dominator retains access to their known jutsu while in the body of the Dominated. / The Dominator must maintain concentration on this status, as if it’s an S-Rank Genjutsu or Ninjutsu, that they do not spend chakra to maintain. / The Dominator uses their own attack bonuses and save DC when calculating them for the purpose of casting jutsu. / The Dominator can use any action, attack or special ability that doesn’t cost tenacity die or a special Clan or class specific resource, using their own attack bonuses or Save DC for calculation. / This status ends, if the Dominators original body takes damage. / Dominated Effects / The Dominated forgoes their turn to the Dominator. / The Dominated is aware of all things occurring while under this status. / The Dominated’s body is never a willing creature. / If this Dominated’s body takes damage, they remake their Charisma saving throw, ending this status on a success. / A Dominated creature, cannot be Dominated again for 24 hours. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your experience with Yamanaka jutsu has reached the point where a creature you inflict with Mental Overwrite suffers alternating effects, not normally part of the Mind Body Transfer process. You can recalibrate the mind of your enemies. When you use Mind Body Transfer or a Yamanaka Hijutsu that inflicts Mental Overwrite, you can infuse one of these Recalibrations into the feature or jutsu cast. You begin with 2 different Recalibrations, gaining an additional one at 7th and 15th levels. You can only use one Recalibration as part of any trigger, jutsu or use of Mind Body Transfer.

Beginning at 11th level, you can choose to use 2 Recalibrations as part of any trigger, jutsu or use of Mind Body Transfer.

Un-armored Thoughts

As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you attempt to siphon the mental energy of an affected creature. They suffer a -2 penalty to their next saving throw before the beginning of your next turn and you can ask one question telepathically, as they must answer telepathically. The question must be in a format were answering Yes, No or I don’t Know are acceptable answers, and they must answer truthfully, using one of the 3 answer options available.

Mask of Many Minds

As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to memories they’ve made over the past 48 hours.

Far Thought

As part of using Mind Body Transfer, increase its range by +30 feet. Beginning at 7th level, this recalibration can be applied to Yamanaka Hijutsu you cast. Beginning at 15th level, increase the range bonus this recalibration provides to +60 feet.

Stolen Might

As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to any Taijutsu or Bukijutsu they know. If they would end the Dominating status, you retain knowledge of 2 of such jutsu of your choice. You can cast these jutsu, once each, before forgetting the stolen memories, within the next minute.

Stolen Technique

As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to any Ninjutsu they know. If they would end the Dominating status, you retain knowledge of 2 of such jutsu of your choice. You can cast these jutsu, once each, before forgetting the stolen memories, within the next minute.

Stolen Dreams

As part of Dominating a creature, you gain access to any Genjutsu they know. If they would end the Dominating status, you retain knowledge of 2 of such jutsu of your choice. You can cast these jutsu, once each, before forgetting the stolen memories, within the next minute.

Stupefy - Coordination

As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite now suffer a -1 penalty to all melee or ranged attack and damage rolls for each rank they have.

Stupefy - Control

As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite increase the cost of jutsu they cast by +2 for each rank they have.

Stupefy - Concentration

As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite reduce the number of jutsu they can concentrate on by an amount equal to half the number of ranks they have.

Stupefy - Migraine

As part of inflicting the Mental Overwrite condition, you recalibrate its effects. Creatures with ranks of Mental Overwrite take 1d8 psychic damage at the beginning of each of their turns for each rank they have.

Efficient Mind

As part of casting a Yamanaka Hijutsu, you can reduce its cost by an amount equal to its rank. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)

Shared Perception

7th Level Clan Feature

The Yamanaka clan is capable of sharing their thoughts as a result of their Telepathic Comms trait. But even that, isn’t always enough.

All creatures linked with your Telepathic Comms trait can spend 1 minute focusing on another willing creature linked with your Telepathic Comms trait. The focusing creature can now perceive through the target creatures senses, replacing them with your own. Creatures can only share in this perception for up to 1 hour, before needing a rest to share senses again.

Psionic Network

11th Level Clan Feature

Your mind generates a psionic pinging system, capable of mentally tracking the locations of anyone in or out of combat, so long as they are capable of sentient thought.

You gain a unique special sense, called Psionic Awareness, which only Yamanaka can ever manifest.

Psionic Awareness. You can perceive the presence and location of sentient thought. Creatures that are capable of complex thought like that of a human, sage beast, or other mentally capable creatures (GM has final say on which creatures qualify).

All creatures within 30 feet of you that qualify as being able to have complex thought, and are not incapacitate or unconscious are made aware to you.

Creatures that you’ve sensed before are familiar to you, and you can connect the sensation of sensing them to their name and face.

You are always aware of creatures with complex though within range.

Creatures with resistance to any Mental condition or conditions with the [Mental] tag, cannot be sensed with this sense.

This sense does not rely on sight, penetrating walls up to 1 feet thick, so as it’s not chakra based or reinforced.

This sense does not pinpoint their location, only their existence and relative distance from or direction from you.

By spending 1 minute focusing you can expand this range up to 120 feet.

If you spend 10 minutes focusing you can expand this range up to 1 mile.

If you spend 1 hour focusing, you can expand this range up to 100 miles.

When expanding the range of this send out to 1 mile or greater, to avoid overloading your mind, you must be looking for a creature familiar to you.

You can only maintain this expanded range up to 1 minute.

If the range is expanded to 1 mile or greater, you can maintain it for 1 minute, but only while stationary.

Deep Disruption

15th Level Clan Feature

Your mastery over invasive mental obstructions allow you to rewrite how an enemy responds to hostile intent.

You can now choose to use Mind Body Transfer as a Bonus action instead of an Action. If you do, you cannot use the Mind Body Transfer as an Action.

Additionally, while you are Dominating a creature, if they would succeed their saving throw to end the Dominated status, you can spend your reaction and reduce the ranks of Mental Overwrite by 1, and extend the duration by one additional round. A creature with 0 ranks of Mental Overwrite automatically ends the Dominated status.
